sloka: तत्र पंचजनम् हत्वा हयग्रीवम् च दानवम् ।आजहार ततः चक्रम् शंखम् च पुरुषोत्तमः ॥४-४२-२८॥
transliteration: tatra paṁcajanam hatvā hayagrīvam ca dānavam ।ājahāra tataḥ cakram śaṁkham ca puruṣottamaḥ ॥4-42-28॥

translations.english: 'It was there that the Supreme Lord Visnu, having slain Hayagriva and Panchajanam, recovered the discus and conch for himself.
